vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇮🇳 Hindi. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Gabriela, Michelle, Daniel and Kevin met them at the door — 4 put down. Gabriela, Michelle, Daniel, Kevin are hurt.
🛡️ Gabriela, Michelle, Kevin and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gabriela, Michelle, Daniyar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Michelle just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Daniyar, Ursula and Maya met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Daniyar, Ursula, Maya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniel just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

regDeaths.name: a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
